claims: England and Uruguay drew 1-1 in a friendly at Wembley Stadium on March 27, 2026 ahead of the FIFA World Cup.
A stoppage-time penalty from Real Madrid’s Federico Valverde secured the draw for Uruguay.
Uruguay's Joaquin Piquerez was stretchered off early following a duel.
England took the lead through defender Ben White.
Uruguay intense pressure led to a penalty in the final moments.
England's Noni Madueke left the game after a blow to the head.
The match was a pre-2026 FIFA World Cup international friendly.
